summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its subsidiary KB Securities' capital increase via issuance of 56,753,688 common shares at KRW 17,620 per share (aggregate KRW 1 trillion) for working capital. Subscription by existing shareholders is expected on July 22, 2026, with a 0.1709687 share allocation per share held. Shares are locked up for one year at KSD. This is a routine equity raise, not a special situation, as it involves a wholly-owned subsidiary increasing capital for working capital purposes.
